label: Academic researcher
rubric_lens: Judge the citation trail, methodology, and gap analysis an academic reader needs.

label: Journalist / analyst
rubric_lens: Judge whether a verdict is supported, contradiction is reported, and confidence is justified.

label: Software engineer
rubric_lens: Judge technical specificity, code-source quality, and whether the provider chain is explained.

label: Operations / maintainer
rubric_lens: Judge operational accuracy, remediation specificity, and whether a reload is explained as non-destructive.

label: Knowledge-base user
rubric_lens: Judge whether the KB round trip is honest: ingest, recall, dedup, and scoped delete.

label: Research writer
rubric_lens: Judge whether the writing skill produced a structured, cited deliverable for its stated audience.
